standard.summary: 每次读取 caption 时随机打乱标签顺序，防止模型对固定标签位置产生依赖。
standard.effect: 开启后同一张图片的 caption 标签顺序每次不同，增强模型对标签排列的鲁棒性。
standard.whenToUse: 几乎所有使用逗号分隔 tag 的训练都推荐开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 使用自然语言 caption（完整句子）时应关闭；keep_tokens > 0 时前 N 个 token 保持不动。

standard_en.summary: Shuffles the tag order randomly each time a caption is read, which stops the model relying on fixed tag positions.
standard_en.effect: Once enabled, the same image's caption tags come in a different order every time, which makes the model more robust to tag ordering.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended for almost any training that uses comma-separated tags.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Turn it off when using natural-language captions (full sentences); with keep_tokens > 0 the first N tokens stay put.

advanced.principle: CLIP/TE tokenizer 对 token 位置有隐式位置编码。固定顺序会让模型学到 '第一个词最重要'。打乱后模型被迫从语义而非位置来理解每个标签。shuffle_caption_tags_only 只打乱 tag 而保留自然语言部分。
advanced.intervention: 在 DataLoader __getitem__ 时对 caption 字符串进行 split/shuffle/join。
advanced.expectedImpact: 降低标签位置过拟合；对生成多样性和 prompt 灵活性有帮助。
advanced.tradeoffs: keep_tokens 保持前 N 个 token（通常是触发词）不打乱；tag_group_shuffle 在组内打乱而非全局打乱。

advanced_en.principle: CLIP/TE tokenizers have implicit position encoding over token positions. A fixed order teaches the model 'the first word matters most'. After shuffling, the model is forced to understand each tag by semantics rather than position. shuffle_caption_tags_only shuffles only the tags and keeps the natural-language part.
advanced_en.intervention: At DataLoader __getitem__ time, the caption string is split/shuffled/joined.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Reduces tag-position overfitting; helps generation diversity and prompt flexibility.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: keep_tokens keeps the first N tokens (usually trigger words) unshuffled; tag_group_shuffle shuffles within groups instead of globally.
